chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad and another, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I asked al-Rida عليه السلام about the grave of Fatimah عليها السلام, so he said: She was buried in her house. Then when Banu Umayyah expanded the mosque, she came to be within the mosque.

key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the mosque whose expanded boundary came to include the burial site
key_terms.بَنُو أُمَيَّةَ: the Umayyad clan who later enlarged the mosque
key_terms.بَيْتِهَا: her house, identified as her original place of burial
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fatimah عليها السلام, the daughter of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.قَبْرِ: grave or burial place being asked about

ai.seo_question: Where is the grave of Fatimah عليها السلام according to Imam al-Rida عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records Imam al-Rida عليه السلام answering a question about the burial place of Fatimah عليها السلام. He states that she was buried in her house, and that later expansion of the mosque by Banu Umayyah caused her grave to fall within the mosque's area.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad and somone else, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr who said,

‘I asked Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> about the grave of (Syeda) Fatima<sup>asws</sup>’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She<sup>asws</sup> is buried in her<sup>asws</sup> house. So when the Clan of Umayya increased in the (boundaries) of the Masjid, she<sup>asws</sup> came to be in the Masjid’.
en.sarwar: 8. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ali from Ali ibn Ja‘far who has said the following. “I heard abu al-Hassan (a.s.) say, ‘Once when the Messenger of Allah was sitting an angel who had twenty four faces came to him. The Messenger of Allah said to him, “My friend Jibril, I had not seen you in this form before.” The angel said, “ Iam not Jibril, O Muhammad. Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious, has sent me to join in marriage the light with the light.” He then asked, “Who with who?” The angel said, “Fatima and Ali (a.s.).” The Imam (a.s.) said, “When the angel turned back on his shoulder it said, “Muhammad the Messenger of Allah, and Ali (a.s.) the executor of his will.”
The Messenger of Allah asked, “Since when this has been written on your shoulder?” The angel replied, “It was there twenty two thousand year before Allah created Adam.”
